themes.name: Arctic Focus
themes.psychology: Blue lowers arousal and is associated with trust and concentration; ideal default for long coding and reading sessions.

themes.name: Midnight Focus
themes.psychology: Deep navy keeps the calming effect of blue while cutting glare at night; periwinkle accents keep focus cues visible.

themes.name: Deep Forest
themes.psychology: Green is linked to balance and low visual fatigue; dark teal-green suits extended monitoring of long pipeline runs.

themes.name: Harbor
themes.psychology: Steel blue on warm sand reads as dependable and precise, well suited to financial review (Cost & P&L).

themes.name: Royal Ink
themes.psychology: Purple is associated with creativity and imagination; a yellow accent adds optimism. Good for ideation and image generation.

themes.name: Spring Grove
themes.psychology: Greens signal growth and progress; lime adds energy. Because green also means success, status colors are hue-shifted to avoid confusion.

themes.name: Berry Dusk
themes.psychology: Plum and rose convey warmth and emotional depth; cream softens the intensity. Suited to writing and conversational chat.

themes.name: Espresso
themes.psychology: Browns evoke reliability and comfort with low stimulation, reducing visual noise while reading documentation.

themes.name: Blush Lavender
themes.psychology: Soft pinks and lavender are associated with calm and stress relief; text is darkened for legibility.

themes.name: Vintage Dawn
themes.psychology: Cream with dusty blue and mauve feels unhurried and reflective, good for planning and reading specs.

themes.name: Sherbet
themes.psychology: Coral warmth plus mint freshness lifts mood and approachability; best for casual chat and brainstorming.

themes.name: Peach Cream
themes.psychology: Peach tones are perceived as warm and approachable with low arousal; easy on the eyes in daylight.

themes.name: Candy Floss
themes.psychology: Warm pastel pinks feel gentle and cheerful; accents are deepened so interactive elements stay discoverable.

themes.name: Lemon Sky
themes.psychology: Soft yellow brings optimism and energy while periwinkle blue keeps focus, a balance for productive daytime work.

themes.name: Honey Sand
themes.psychology: Golden sand tones read as warm and positive with little blue-light character, pleasant for evening use without full dark mode.

themes.name: Autumn Ember
themes.psychology: Ember orange adds warmth and enthusiasm, balanced by cool slate-teal for composure: energetic without being aggressive.

themes.name: Summer Meadow
themes.psychology: Olive and terracotta are earthy and organic; they signal stability and ease, good for steady routine work.

themes.name: Winter Stone
themes.psychology: Muted greys minimise emotional and visual stimulation and let content dominate: a focus-mode theme.

themes.name: Neon Gold
themes.psychology: Warm near-black surfaces reduce glare while restrained gold accents identify actions and large metrics. Amber adds warmth without turning the whole workspace into a warning signal.

themes.name: Neon Cyan
themes.psychology: Cool cyan focus cues distinguish interactive controls from quiet charcoal surfaces; blue secondary accents support clear navigation during coding and monitoring.

themes.name: Neon Violet
themes.psychology: Soft violet accents bring a creative mood to near-black surfaces, with restrained glow that keeps reading and ideation comfortable over long sessions.
